decisions.reason: As an established distributor of print-finishing equipment, the firm can carry this basic perfect binder at low cost with existing slack, and there is no evidence of a shortfall below aspiration, though COVID-hit print demand and supplier model changes leave some risk of it being dropped.

The fully automatic binder rounds out the binding range for professional print shops and carries higher margins, so without clear evidence of underperformance management is unlikely to start problemistic search and drop it.

Booklet makers for inline and nearline use fit the core post-press offering and steady demand from print shops, so keeping the product is consistent with satisficing behaviour in the absence of negative signals.
